=== BEGIN ci/PIPELINE.md ===
   1| ## 3. Pipeline
   2| 
   3| Harbor Docs builds its documentation site from the main repository. Every push to a merge request
   4| starts a run of the pipeline. The table lists the stages in the order they run.
   5| 
   6| | Stage | Waits for | Does |
   7| | :--- | :--- | :--- |
   8| | lint | the push | checks Markdown style and front matter |
   9| | unit tests | lint | tests the plugins of the site generator |
  10| | build site | unit tests | turns the Markdown pages into static HTML |
  11| | link check | build site | follows every link in the built HTML |
  12| | accessibility check | build site | checks contrast, heading order and alt text |
  13| | deploy preview | link check, accessibility check | uploads the built site to a preview address |
  14| | publish | deploy preview | copies the previewed site to the public host |
  15| 
  16| - **PL-1.** A stage starts only after every stage it waits for has passed.
  17| - **PL-2.** The link check and the accessibility check run in parallel.
  18| - **PL-3.** A failed stage stops the run. The next push starts a new run from lint.
  19| - **PL-4.** Publish also needs a maintainer approval, recorded as a comment in the merge request.
  20|   Until the approval is recorded, the run waits at publish.
  21| 
  22| ### 3.1 Limits
  23| 
  24| - **PL-5.** The link check stops after 20 min and fails.
  25| - **PL-6.** Preview sites are deleted 7 days after the merge request closes.
=== END ci/PIPELINE.md ===
